pwa.hintTitle: Put this app on your home screen
pwa.hintBody: Then you start it from an icon of its own — no address bar, like any other app.
pwa.dialogIntro: The app gets an icon of its own and opens in its own window. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is installed that you would have to remove again.
pwa.stepsPrompt: Tap “Install” — your browser takes it from there.
pwa.stepsAndroid: Open the browser menu (the three dots, top right) and choose “Install app”.
pwa.stepsIos: Tap “Share” in the bar at the bottom, then pick “Add to Home Screen” from the list.
pwa.stepsIosSignIn: You will sign in once more the first time you open it: on iPhone the installed app has a sign-in of its own. A password — which you can set under “My account” — is the easiest way in.
pwa.stepsDesktop: Tap “Install” — your browser takes it from there.
pwa.stepsWebview: This view does not offer it. Open the page in your phone's own browser — the entry is in its menu.

home.title: {app}
home.subtitle: This template is ready to sell through Digistore24: accounts, a protected area and checkout are already in place.
home.setupHint: Connect your Digistore24 account once from the terminal: node run.mjs ds24-connect

features.authTitle: Sign in by link or password
features.authBody: Magic link by email, password optional, Google optional. Accounts and roles are built in.
features.billingBody: Checkout, subscriptions and token credit — purchases arrive as signed IPN events.
features.readyBody: Light and dark mode, German and English, database and tests included.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your email address — what happens next depends on whether you have a password.
login.linkInstead: Email me a sign-in link instead
login.devReason: because no email delivery is set up
login.devHintAny: Sign in with any email address — the first account becomes the admin
login.blockedBody: The operator has blocked access to this account. Get in touch with them if you think this is a mistake.
login.errorBody: The sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
login.missingBody: Set up email delivery (Postmark or SMTP) — Google is optional. See docs/auth-setup.md and .env.example.
login.passwordFailedBody: That email address and password do not match. Forgotten your password? Have a sign-in link emailed to you instead — you can set a new password afterwards under “My account”. After several failed attempts it takes a few minutes before you can try again.
login.noWayInTitle: Signing in is not possible right now
login.noWayInBody: This address has no password, and no email delivery is set up — so there is nothing this sign-in could be confirmed with. Get in touch with the operator.
login.tooManyAttemptsBody: Too many addresses were checked in quick succession. Wait a few minutes and then try again.
login.signInFailedBody: The sign-in could not be completed. Try again — if it keeps happening, get in touch with the operator.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.ds24Body: The connection is made in the terminal, not here — that way the key goes straight into your .env and never into the database or the browser:
dashboard.planBody: See what you offer, or book a plan.
dashboard.nextPaymentBody: Your subscription renews on this day.
dashboard.purchaseTokens: {credits, plural, one {# token has been added to your balance.} other {# tokens have been added to your balance.}}
dashboard.onboardingPlanBody: Pick a plan — everything that comes with it opens up straight away.
dashboard.onboardingTokensBody: With tokens you pay for what you actually use.

onboarding.title: Your first steps
onboarding.body: What is still open before you can get going.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your sign-in details, what you can use right now and how much balance you hold.
account.balanceHint: Where you stand today. If support corrects it, the new figure is here the next time you load this page.
account.balanceEmpty: You have not bought any balance yet.
account.accessEmptyBody: Once you buy a plan it shows up here — usually within a few minutes of the payment.
account.accessHint: “Access until” is the last day you can use the plan. A running subscription has no end date here: it keeps going for as long as it is paid. When the next payment is due is on the overview — that is a billing date, not the end of your access.
account.pausedBody: A payment did not go through, so your access to {plans} is on hold. Your account and your data stay exactly as they are — as soon as the payment succeeds, everything is back.
account.moreBody: Every plan and package at a glance.
account.accessPausedBody: Your plan is not gone — it is on hold until the payment goes through.
account.signInDescription: How you get into your account. The sign-in link by email always works — a password is optional and only ever adds to it.
account.passwordSetHint: You can sign in with your email address and password, without waiting for mail.
account.passwordUnsetHint: You sign in with a link by email. A password saves you the trip to your inbox — it is not required.
account.passwordRemoveHint: You will sign in with a link by email again afterwards. Your access, your balance and your plans stay exactly as they are — and you can set a new password whenever you like.
account.passwordDialogHint: At least {min} characters. Length counts for more than special characters — pick something long that you will remember.
account.passwordRemoved: Password removed. You sign in with a link by email again now.
account.emailHint: This is where sign-in links go. A change only takes effect once you confirm it from the new mailbox.
account.emailChangeHint: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. Until you follow it nothing changes — your current address keeps working.
account.emailChangeRequested: Confirmation link sent to {email}. Nothing changes until you follow it.
account.pendingBody: We sent a link to {email} — valid until {until}. Your current address keeps working normally until then. If you mistyped it, simply request the change again with the right address; that replaces this one.
account.emailChangeNoMail: Changing your address needs email delivery set up for this app — the change is confirmed by a link sent to the new address.

admin.title: Admin
admin.usersBody: Create users, switch roles between admin and user, change email addresses, send sign-in links, block or delete accounts.
admin.purchasesBody: Purchases that reached no account — attach them by hand.
admin.aiCostsBody: What AI cost — by task, by model and over time, including what the total cannot account for.
admin.ownerOnlyBody: This page is protected with requireOwner() — a blueprint for your own admin features. Admins can also be created from the terminal:
admin.setupKeysBody: Keys your coding agent uses to set this environment up — and the record of what it did.

users.title: Users
users.description: {count, plural, =0 {No users yet} one {# user} other {# users}} · you are signed in as {email}
users.createDescription: The new user signs in with a link they request themselves. They can give themselves a password later — you cannot set one for them.
users.name: Name
users.changeEmailDescription: The address is the way in: from now on the sign-in link goes to the new one. Whoever held the old address can no longer get in.
users.blockBody: Access ends immediately — including any session already running. The account's data is kept, and you can lift the block at any time.
users.deleteBody: The account and all its sign-ins will be removed. This cannot be undone.
users.emptyBody: Create the first one — they'll get a link by email the next time they sign in.
users.hint: The same works from the terminal with node run.mjs user-create.
users.impersonateBody: You will see the app exactly as this customer does and can act on their behalf. A banner will show whose account you are in, the session ends by itself after 30 minutes, and it is recorded.

memberBilling.title: Billing state
memberBilling.description: Balance, bookings and entitlements of this account.
memberBilling.balanceEmpty: No token account yet — nothing has ever been credited or spent.
memberBilling.reloadPausedBody: {count, plural, one {# top-up was charged} other {# top-ups were charged}} to this member's payment method and no credit ever arrived, so no further charge will be made. The member's own setting is still switched on — what stopped is the charging, not their choice. Check the Digistore24 IPN configuration; charging resumes by itself once a credit is booked, or when the member switches auto top-up off and on again.
memberBilling.ledgerEmptyBody: Nothing has been credited to or spent from this account.
memberBilling.ledgerTruncated: Only the {count} most recent bookings are shown.
memberBilling.grantsEmptyBody: This account has never held access to a plan.
memberBilling.adjustReasonPlaceholder: e.g. goodwill credit for support case #42
memberBilling.adjustHint: A positive amount credits, a negative one takes away. The reason stays in the journal for good.
memberBilling.adjustConfirmBody: The correction is booked immediately and stays in the journal. Reason: {reason}
memberBilling.grantHint: Gives this account access to a plan — with no payment behind it. For a purchase that could not be matched, or as a goodwill comp.
memberBilling.grantKeyHint: Without a date the grant is permanent. With one, access ends at the END of the chosen day — no scheduled job is involved. A plan later removed from the product list can only be got rid of by a migration from then on.
memberBilling.grantNoProducts: There is no plan to grant — the product list holds token packages only.
memberBilling.revokeConfirmBody: Access that came from a purchase is unaffected: if this account also bought the same plan and that purchase is still active, it keeps it. If the purchase is currently suspended — after a missed payment, say — the account loses the plan entirely.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.description: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing has been bought yet.} one {One purchase recorded.} other {# purchases recorded.}}
purchases.descriptionFiltered: {count, plural, =0 {No purchase matches the filter.} one {One purchase matches the filter.} other {# purchases match the filter.}}
purchases.filterEmptyBody: No purchase matches this combination of filters. Reset them to see all of them again.
purchases.attachDescription: The purchase is credited to the chosen account — exactly as it would have been on sign-in.
purchases.attachFailed_alreadyAttributed: The purchase has since been attached already.
purchases.attachFailed_notClaimable: This purchase was refunded or charged back — it cannot be attached to an account.
purchases.attached: {count, plural, =0 {Purchase attached.} one {Purchase attached, one credit booked.} other {Purchase attached, # credits booked.}}
purchases.emptyBody: As soon as Digistore24 reports a purchase, it shows up here.
purchases.ipnEmptyBody: As soon as Digistore24 sends an IPN it shows up here — including rejected ones and connection tests.
purchases.ipnDetailsHint: The full payload exactly as Digistore24 sent it. Automatically deleted after 60 days.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Your purchases, invoices and subscription management.
billing.emptyBody: As soon as you buy something, your invoices and subscription controls show up here.
billing.noInvoices: No invoice for this purchase yet.
billing.cancelDescription: You'll be taken to Digistore24 to complete the cancellation. Your access remains until the end of the period you paid for.
billing.tokensBalanceHint: What is left to use right now.
billing.tokensEmptyBody: As soon as tokens are credited or used, every booking is listed here.
billing.tokensTruncatedBody: Only the latest {limit} bookings are shown. Older ones are not listed here.
billing.autoReloadOnBody: When your balance falls to {threshold} or below, {package} ({price}) is purchased again automatically and charged to your stored payment details.
billing.autoReloadOnBodyUnknownPackage: When your balance falls to {threshold} or below, tokens are purchased again automatically and charged to your stored payment details.
billing.autoReloadOffBody: Your payment details from buying {package} are still on file, so you can switch automatic top-up back on without buying again.
billing.autoReloadDisabled: Automatic top-up is off. Your card will not be charged again.
billing.autoReloadEnableFailed: Automatic top-up could not be turned on. Please try again.
billing.autoReloadDisableFailed: Automatic top-up could not be turned off. Please try again — if it keeps failing, contact support.
billing.autoReloadNoMandate: There are no stored payment details to charge. Buy a token package to set automatic top-up up again.

chat.title: Ask {name}
chat.subtitle: Answers to any question about this app — around the clock.
chat.emptyTitle: What would you like to know?
chat.emptyBody: {name} knows this app inside out and is happy to answer any question. She cannot see your account — your balance, purchases and settings stay hidden from her.
chat.disclaimer: {name} is an AI. She can be wrong — for anything about money or access, ask support.
chat.clearBody: The whole conversation will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
chat.offDisabledInConfig: The assistant is switched off. Set "enabled" to true in config/ai-chat.json.
chat.offNoApiKey: She is bound to the provider {provider} (config/ai-models.json → tasks.chat), and its key {envVar} is not in .env. Either put it there — or bind the task to the provider whose key you already have. A key from another company does not count here. In the terminal: node run.mjs ai-check
chat.offBrokenConfig: config/ai-chat.json does not hold together. node run.mjs kb-check says what is wrong.
chat.offForMember: {name} is not available in this app at the moment.
chat.noAccessBody: The assistant belongs to a plan this account does not hold.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: All prices include VAT where applicable. Billing is handled by Digistore24.
plans.oneTimeBody: Pay once — no subscription, no follow-up costs.
plans.tokensBody: Buy once, spend as you go — no subscription.
plans.checkoutFailedTitle: The checkout could not be started
plans.checkoutFailedBody: Please try again shortly. Nothing was charged.
plans.emptyBody: Plans live in config/digistore-products.json — add them there and they'll show up here.
plans.blocked_error: Checkout is currently unavailable. Please try again shortly.
plans.autoReloadLabel: Keep my balance topped up automatically
plans.previewTitle: Preview — nothing can be bought here
plans.previewBody: This page shows the buy forms as a visitor would see them once the products exist at Digistore24. Nothing was asked of Digistore24, and none of these buttons leads to a checkout: “Buy” lands on the same error message it otherwise would. This preview exists only on your own machine (APP_ENV=development and localhost) — a published app does not have it. For a real checkout: node run.mjs ds24-connect and node run.mjs ds24-sync.
plans.previewOffer: No Digistore24 products yet — you can still look at the buy forms:
plans.autoReloadHint: When it runs low, this package is purchased again at the same price and charged to the payment details from this purchase. You can turn it off at any time under Billing.

optin.title: Thanks for your purchase!
optin.processing: Your order is being processed! Please wait …
optin.slowTitle: This is taking longer than usual
optin.slowBody: Your order hasn't reached us yet. Please check your inbox (including the spam folder) — your access is on its way there. If nothing arrives, please contact support.
optin.signInBody: Sign in with the email address you paid with — your purchase is then attached to your account automatically.

ds24Connected.title: Access approved
ds24Connected.body: Digistore24 has granted the access. You can close this window — the setup finishes in your terminal.

email.subject: Your sign-in link
email.heading: Sign in
email.body: Click the button to sign in. The link is valid for 24 hours.
email.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link:
email.textBody: Open this link to sign in (valid for 24 hours):
email.loginIgnore: Didn't try to sign in? Just ignore this email — nothing happens without a click on the link.
email.credentialHeading: Something changed about how you sign in
email.credential_passwordSet: A password was created for your account. You can now sign in with your email address and password — the sign-in link by email keeps working.
email.credential_passwordRemoved: Your account password was removed. You sign in with a link by email again from now on.
email.credentialNotYou: Was this not you? Then somebody has access to your account. Get in touch with the operator straight away. This message deliberately contains no link — nobody impersonating us can change anything about your account through it.
email.credentialSubject_passwordSet: Security notice: a password was created for your account
email.credentialSubject_passwordChanged: Security notice: your password was changed
email.credentialSubject_passwordRemoved: Security notice: your password was removed
email.confirmEmailSubjectForApp: Confirm your new email address for {app}
email.confirmEmailBody: Somebody wants to move an account to {email}. If that was you, use the button — the change only takes effect once you do. The link is valid for 24 hours. If it was not you, just ignore this mail and nothing will happen.
email.confirmEmailText: Open this link to confirm {email} as your account's new address (valid for 24 hours). If this was not you, ignore this mail and nothing will happen:
email.credential_emailChanged: Your account was moved to the address {email}. You can no longer get in using this one.
email.credentialSubject_emailChanged: Security notice: your account was moved to a different address

errors.alreadyImpersonating: You are already signed in as somebody else. End that first.
errors.altRequired: Please describe briefly what the picture shows — people who cannot see it hear this text.
errors.changeNotFound: This confirmation link is not valid, or a newer request replaced it.
errors.chatFailed: The answer could not be generated. Please try again.
errors.chatMessageTooLong: That question is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.chatNoAccess: The assistant needs a plan this account does not hold.
errors.chatNoKnowledge: No knowledge has been set up for the assistant yet.
errors.chatRateLimited: That was a lot of questions in a short time. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.chatUnavailable: The assistant is not available right now.
errors.emailNotConfigured: No email delivery is set up. In the terminal: node run.mjs mail-setup
errors.emailTaken: That email address already belongs to another account.
errors.emailUnchanged: That is already your address — there is nothing to change.
errors.emptyReason: Please give a reason — it is the only record of why the balance was changed by hand.
errors.endDateInPast: That end date is in the past — the grant would have expired the moment it was issued.
errors.fileDamaged: That file looks damaged — it did not arrive in one piece. Please try sending it again.
errors.impersonationDisabled: Signing in as a user is switched off for this app (config/impersonation.json).
errors.insufficientBalance: The balance is not that high. It has been left unchanged.
errors.invalidAmount: Please enter a whole number, e.g. 100 or -50.
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.invalidEndDate: That end date is unreadable. Pick a day in YYYY-MM-DD form, or leave the field empty.
errors.invalidReason: Please give a readable reason (max. 500 characters).
errors.kindNotDirect: Pictures take the ordinary upload route, not the direct one — location data is removed from them on the way in.
errors.lastOwnerBlock: This is the last admin — they cannot be blocked.
errors.lastOwnerDelete: This is the last admin — they cannot be deleted.
errors.lastOwnerRole: This is the last admin — their role cannot be changed.
errors.mailNotConfigured: This app has no email delivery set up yet. Without it no confirmation link can be sent — and without that link no address changes. Your current address keeps working exactly as before.
errors.moderatorImpersonate: Moderators cannot be signed in as — signing in is for regular user accounts only.
errors.noAccess: You do not have access to that.
errors.noCredential: No key is configured for this AI provider. Add it to your .env.
errors.noFile: There was no file in that.
errors.noPasswordSet: This account has no password set.
errors.noPurposes: This app asks for no consent.
errors.nonMemberImpersonate: This account cannot be signed in as — signing in is for regular user accounts only.
errors.notAGrantProduct: Token packages are balance, not entitlement. Correct the token balance instead.
errors.notAllowedForRole: You are not allowed to upload this kind of file here.
errors.notImpersonating: You are not signed in as anybody else.
errors.notManual: That grant came from a purchase — it cannot be revoked by hand.
errors.notSignedIn: Please sign in to upload a file.
errors.ownerImpersonate: Admins cannot be signed in as — they hold the same rights you do.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.passwordWrong: That is not your current password.
errors.providerFailed: The AI request failed. The details are in the log: node run.mjs logs
errors.providerRefused: The AI provider turned the request down just now (overloaded, or a limit was reached). Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.providerUnreachable: The AI provider could not be reached. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many uploads in a short time. Try again in an hour.
errors.reasonRequired: Please write a reason — it goes into the record.
errors.requestTooLarge: The request is too large for this model.
errors.selfBlock: You cannot block yourself — you would not get back in to lift it.
errors.selfDelete: You cannot delete yourself. Ask another admin to remove you.
errors.selfDemote: You cannot take away your own admin rights.
errors.selfImpersonate: You are already signed in as yourself.
errors.storeUnavailable: File storage is not reachable right now. That is the app's problem, not yours.
errors.tokensNotSold: This app does not sell tokens. Set "billingMode" in config/digistore-products.json to "tokens" or "both" to correct a balance.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests in a short time. Wait about an hour and try again — your current address keeps working exactly as before.
errors.typeMismatch: The file is not what its name claims it is.
errors.typeNotAllowed: This kind of file is not accepted here.
errors.unknownModel: This AI provider does not know that model. Check the model name in the configuration.
errors.unknownProduct: There is no such product key. Check config/digistore-products.json.
errors.unknownPurpose: This app does not (or no longer) ask for that consent.
errors.uploadMissing: The file never arrived in storage. Please upload it again.
errors.uploadTicketInvalid: This upload has expired or does not belong to you. Start it again.
errors.userBlocked: This account is blocked. Lift the block before sending a sign-in link.
errors.userWithoutEmail: This account has no email address — there is nowhere to send the link.
errors.zeroAmount: 0 is not a correction — please enter an amount other than zero.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email address
confirmEmail.successBody: Your account is now reachable at {email}. Sign-in links go there from now on.
confirmEmail.alreadyBody: This change was already confirmed — your account is reachable at {email}. There is nothing left to do.
confirmEmail.failedHint: Sign in and request the change again under “My account”. Your current address keeps working exactly as before.

aiCosts.title: AI costs
aiCosts.description: What AI cost in this period — {range}.
aiCosts.totalExcludes: {count, plural, one {# call is not included — no price on file for its model} other {# calls are not included — no price on file for their models}}.
aiCosts.callsFailed: {count, plural, one {# of them failed} other {# of them failed}}
aiCosts.cacheHint: Share of input tokens that came from the prompt cache. If this collapses, the stable prompt prefix has been broken — the answers stay correct and the bill goes up.
aiCosts.cacheNone: No input tokens in this period.
aiCosts.unpricedTitle: {count, plural, one {# call with no price} other {# calls with no price}}
aiCosts.unpricedBody: These models have no entry in config/ai-prices.json. The calls happened and the tokens were counted — they are simply missing from the total above. Add the prices and the page accounts for every call from the next one on.
aiCosts.unpricedRow: {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} · {tokens} tokens
aiCosts.unexplainedTitle: {tokens} tokens the provider did not itemise
aiCosts.unexplainedBody: These providers billed for more tokens than they broke down. The difference is estimated at the output rate and is part of the total above — across the five providers that ship here, this should stay empty.
aiCosts.unexplainedRow: {tokens} tokens across {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}}
aiCosts.failedTitle: {count, plural, one {# failed call} other {# failed calls}}
aiCosts.failedBody: Failed calls are shown here and not in the spend. Many identical failures at once is the pattern that gives away a runaway process or a bad day at the provider.
aiCosts.pricesUpdated: Prices last checked on {date} (config/ai-prices.json). Nothing fetches them.
aiCosts.pricesUnknown: config/ai-prices.json does not say when the prices were last checked.
aiCosts.callsCapped: The last {count} calls only — the figures above cover the whole period.
aiCosts.noContentNote: Numbers only: no question, no answer, and no text anybody typed.
aiCosts.emptyBody: The app has not called a model in this period. As soon as it does, what it cost shows up here.
aiCosts.emptyNoKeyBody: The app has not called a model in this period — and the provider it is bound to has no key in your .env. Run node run.mjs ai-check to see which one.
aiCosts.callsNoneInGroup: No calls match this selection in the period. The link may be older than the data — “Show all calls” takes you back.

impersonation.signedInAs: You are signed in as {member} — you are {operator}.
impersonation.ended: The session as another user has ended — you are yourself again.
impersonation.title: Signed in as user
impersonation.description: Every time an admin signed in as a customer. Access is recorded; what was done while inside is not.
impersonation.emptyTitle: Nobody has signed in as a user yet
impersonation.emptyBody: When an admin signs in as a customer from the user list, it is recorded here.
impersonation.hint: Rows closed automatically say when the session was due to end, not that the admin was present until that moment. Kept for 12 months.

consent.title: Consents
consent.description: What you have said yes or no to. You can change any of it at any time — withdrawing is exactly as easy as agreeing.
consent.none: This app asks you for no consent. What it does needs none: the purchase runs on the contract, and the only cookies set are the ones the app needs to work or the ones you switched yourself.
consent.withdrawHint: You can change this at any time under “Account”.
consent.staleHint: The text you agreed to has been changed. Until you decide again, no consent applies.

privacy.exportBody: A copy of everything this app holds about you — as a JSON file you can also read elsewhere.
privacy.exportHint: Includes your account, your purchases, your balance with every entry, your chat transcripts and every time an operator signed in to your account.
privacy.exportExcluded: Not included: your password (it cannot be read back) and the raw data from our payment provider, because it can contain details about other people.
privacy.deleteBody: You can delete your account yourself at any time. Some of your data has to be kept for legal reasons — the confirmation says exactly what.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out immediately.
privacy.deleteGoesBody: Your account and your access, your chat transcripts, the plans unlocked for you, any pending address change, and your consents.
privacy.deleteStaysBody: Your orders and invoices. They are accounting records we are required to keep (§ 147 AO, § 257 HGB) — and the GDPR exempts exactly those from erasure (Art. 17(3)(b)). The link to your account is removed.
privacy.deleteSubscriptionTitle: You still have an active plan
privacy.deleteSubscriptionBody: Deleting your account does NOT cancel your subscription. Billing continues at Digistore24 until you stop it there — cancel there first, or you will keep paying for access you no longer have.
privacy.deleteLastOwnerBody: This app would be left with nobody able to administer it — and nobody who could let you back in. Make somebody else an administrator first, then you can delete your account.

legal.placeholderTitle: This page has not been filled in yet
legal.placeholderBody: The text below is the shipped placeholder, not a valid notice. Run the compliance-check skill to replace it.
legal.otherLanguage: This page is not available in your language yet and is shown in the version that exists.

setupKeys.title: Setup keys
setupKeys.intro: These keys are how your coding agent sets this environment up — creating users, granting plans, uploading media. A key works only here.
setupKeys.offBody: config/setup.json says "enabled": false, so /api/setup answers 404 even to a valid key. You can still mint one now: switching it on is a deploy, and that usually comes afterwards.
setupKeys.createHint: The key is shown exactly once. It belongs in .env, never in a file git tracks.
setupKeys.name: Name
setupKeys.nameRequired: Please give the key a name (2 to 80 characters).
setupKeys.lifetimeInvalid: The lifetime must be between 1 and 3650 days — or left empty.
setupKeys.secretOnce: This is the only time you will see it. There is no looking it up — a lost key is replaced, not recovered.
setupKeys.secretWhere: Copy it into your .env as SETUP_KEY (or SETUP_KEY_STAGING / SETUP_KEY_PROD). .env is listed in .gitignore.
setupKeys.revokeConfirm: “{name}” stops working immediately. This cannot be undone; a program using it is refused on its next call.
setupKeys.revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked.
setupKeys.emptyBody: Mint one when your coding agent should set this environment up.

setupAudit.title: Setup record
setupAudit.intro: Every act of the setup surface, once, unchangeable. Identifiers and numbers — never what was written.
setupAudit.emptyBody: As soon as your agent sets something up here, it appears in this list.

opsWatchdog.subject: {count, plural, =1 {1 thing needs attention} other {# things need attention}} ({severity})
opsWatchdog.heading: {count, plural, =1 {One thing needs your attention} other {# things need your attention}}

condition.security-open: {count, plural, =1 {1 security finding} other {# security findings}} at HIGH or above are open. Run: node run.mjs security-check
